deployments_detail.use: Company-wide rollout of OpenAI's ChatGPT Enterprise as part of a strategic collaboration to become an 'AI-first company'; initial large-scale deployment to DX-driving staff (thousands of IDs planned within 2025) for tasks such as document/report creation, internal manual summarization, and daily/specialized work support. [OpenAI (ChatGPT Enterprise)]
"ChatGPT Enterprise" deployed (from Oct 2024, OpenAI CoE partnership) + AI agents for new-business ideation

Applying OpenAI generative AI to thermal power plant operations, including checking for equipment anomalies and verifying legal/regulatory compliance for construction work, plus AI-based work-plan proposals, legal checks and system isolation support. [OpenAI]

Game-AI-based fuel operation optimization system for coal-fired power plants, jointly developed with DeNA; uses game-AI search algorithms to optimize coal procurement, berth and silo operations, letting less-experienced technicians auto-generate optimal schedules (later commercialized with ALGO ARTIS). [DeNA / ALGO ARTIS]

SenaSon (Smart energy aggregate Solution), Kansai's own AI-based cloud control system that optimizes operation of distributed energy resources (storage batteries, solar) based on electricity-demand and solar-generation forecasts for peak shaving and demand response; being integrated with PowerX BESS for corporate customers. [Kansai Electric Power (in-house), PowerX (BESS integration)]

Autonomous self-driving inspection robot combined with AI to automate patrol inspection of thermal power plants; the robot collects equipment/sensor data and AI diagnoses whether each equipment's operating condition is normal, detecting gas/oil leaks and abnormal high temperatures. Developed with K4 Digital and Kanden Systems. [K4 Digital / Kanden Systems (Seiko Denki robot)]

AI program that automatically image-analyzes and detects drifting ice and snow (ryuhyosetsu) at hydroelectric power plant intakes, to warn of intake blockage; jointly developed with K4 Digital. [K4 Digital]

AI-enabled digital twin of coal-fired power plant operations built on the AVEVA PI System; combines the model with real-time sensor data to optimize combustion/operations and predict issues across all nine of the company's power plants. [AVEVA (PI System)]
deployments_detail.value: asset savings of ~$3 million a year at one plant

deployments_detail.use: AI analysis tool to shorten inspection-related shutdown periods of hydroelectric plants by selecting only the necessary inspections, reducing the months-long downtime required for full teardown inspections; trial deployment planned from FY2023. [none]

Drone plus AI image-analysis technology for operation and maintenance of offshore wind power facilities, used for emergency and periodic inspections of wind turbine generation equipment to speed up and streamline O&M, cut inspection costs and increase power output. [none]

AI-based equipment anomaly-detection systems offered through Kansai's K-VaCS engineering service, where most AI models are built automatically to enable wide-area monitoring and detection of previously unrecognized signs of abnormality in power plant equipment. [Kansai Electric Power (K-VaCS)]

Enudge / Enudge 2.0, an AI-based cloud energy-saving support service for multi-site corporate customers combining AI electricity-demand prediction with behavioral 'nudge' theory to encourage energy-saving actions and centrally manage store energy use; won Japan's Energy Conservation Grand Prize. [Kansai Electric Power / iGrid Solutions]
deployments_detail.value: annual electricity use reduced 3-5% at some facilities

deployments_detail.use: Cyber threat intelligence using CYFIRMA's DeCYFIR platform for dark-web monitoring, attack surface management (ASM), threat-actor tracking and IoC analysis; also adopted the 'Ask DeCYFIR' generative-AI feature for querying threat intelligence in Japanese. [CYFIRMA (DeCYFIR)]
